CANONICAL_NAME.value: pybreaker 1.2.0 -- the Circuit Breaker pattern in Python (Daniel Fernandes Martins)

value.lineage: Nygard's Circuit Breaker (Release It!, 2007): a failure counter trips an OPEN state that fails fast for a reset timeout, then HALF-OPEN probes the dependency. pybreaker (2010-) is a compact, widely-copied Python implementation; the Java relative is Netflix Hystrix (2012, retired 2018).

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: cascading failure containment in service call chains

value.built_to: stop a caller from pounding a failing dependency, and let it recover by probing instead of flooding
value.pressure: a downstream service that fails or slows; retry storms that turn one failure into many
value.success_means: fast failure while the dependency is down, automatic recovery when it heals, no cascading overload

value.pressure: partial failure of a dependency, latency, retry storms
value.failure_condition: callers keep retrying a dead dependency until the caller itself falls over
